short: Dr. Mel Holistic is a naturopathic and functional medicine practice helping adults take a proactive approach to cardiovascular and metabolic health. We specialize in identifying and addressing the underlying factors behind high blood pressure, blood sugar imbalance, cardiovascular plaque, fatigue, and hormone changes using personalized testing, nutrition, natural therapies, and nervous system regulation—helping patients improve their health and reduce their risk of heart attack, stroke, and chronic disease.

long:
Dr. Mel Holistic is a naturopathic and functional medicine practice for people who want to be proactive about their health—not simply manage disease as it progresses. Led by Dr. Melanie Icard, NMD, we specialize in cardiovascular and metabolic health, including blood pressure, blood sugar, cardiovascular plaque, hormones, inflammation, energy, and healthy aging.

We believe there is rarely one cause, one supplement, or one treatment. The body is a system of systems, so we use a personalized, multi-layered approach that may include advanced laboratory testing, nutrition, herbal medicine, lifestyle medicine, nervous system regulation, functional therapies, and physician-guided care.

Our goal is empowerment and accountability: helping you understand your body, improve the underlying terrain, and invest in your greatest asset—your health—so it can take care of you as you age.
size: 3–4 patient-care days per week, with a high-touch private practice accepting a maximum of 6 new private clients per month. I am interested in expanding my overall reach through employer-sponsored preventive health programs, group programs, and aligned healthcare networks, particularly in cardiovascular, metabolic, and stress-related health.
